# Newsweek

> Global news media organization delivering breaking news, analysis, and commentary across politics, world events, business, health, science, and culture.

Newsweek is a leading international news magazine and digital platform founded in 1933, offering comprehensive coverage of current events and in-depth reporting. The site also provides advertising solutions including Homepage Takeover (HPTO), First Impression Takeover (FITO), and various digital ad formats for brand partners.

## Key Topics

- Newsweek
- Homepage Takeover (HPTO)
- First Impression Takeover (FITO)
- Digital Advertising
- Display Advertising
- Native Advertising
- Video Pre-Roll
- Interscroller
- Brand Awareness
- Programmatic Advertising
- Ad Formats

## Advertising Solutions

- [Digital Solutions](https://advertising.newsweek.com/digital-solutions): Newsweek's digital advertising products including Homepage Takeover (HPTO), First Impression Takeover (FITO), Interscroller, Video Pre-Roll, and other premium ad formats for brand awareness and programmatic campaigns
